How to Use

After cleansing, use the textured side of the pad to gently polish skin in small circular motions, avoiding the eye and lip area. Then flip to the soft cotton side to smooth and refresh. Rinse off with lukewarm water after use. Use 2–3 times per week, AM or PM.

Follow with JIYU Toner Pads twice a day to maintain daily glow, then JIYU NAD+ Anti-Aging Cream to lock in hydration and protect. Always wear SPF the morning after use.

Pro tip: Press a pad onto a single blemish for 5–10 minutes as a fast targeted spot treatment.

Glycolic Acid (AHA)

Glycolic Acid is the most studied alpha-hydroxy acid in skincare. Its small molecule size allows it to penetrate the top layer of skin and gently dissolve the bonds between dead skin cells, accelerating the natural exfoliation process.

Clinically shown to:

  • Resurface dull, rough skin
  • Improve texture and tone
  • Stimulate collagen production over time

Salicylic Acid (BHA)

Salicylic Acid is a beta-hydroxy acid that's oil-soluble, allowing it to travel inside the pore lining where water-based ingredients can't reach. There, it dissolves the mix of sebum, dead skin, and bacterial buildup that causes clogged pores and blackheads.

Clinically shown to:

  • Unclog pores and reduce blackheads
  • Calm active breakouts
  • Smooth bumpy, congested texture

Gluconolactone (PHA)

Gluconolactone is a polyhydroxy acid (PHA) with a larger molecular structure than AHAs or BHAs. This means it exfoliates more gradually and only at the surface — making it ideal for sensitive skin or for use alongside stronger acids.

What it does:

  • Gently exfoliates without stinging
  • Acts as a humectant — hydrates while it exfoliates
  • Helps strengthen the skin barrier

Capryloyl Salicylic Acid (LHA)

Capryloyl Salicylic Acid is a derivative of Salicylic Acid with an added fatty acid chain, making it more oil-loving and slower-acting. It targets the very top layer of skin to refine texture and pore appearance without stripping deeper layers.

What it does:

  • Visibly refines pore appearance
  • Smooths surface texture
  • Evens out skin tone

Niacinamide

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is one of the most studied and proven actives in skincare. It works by improving the function of skin cells at multiple levels — supporting barrier function, regulating sebum production, and helping to even out skin tone.

Clinically shown to:

  • Reduce visible pore size
  • Balance oil production
  • Brighten and even skin tone
  • Strengthen the skin barrier

GESOLZA™ Patented Complex

GESOLZA™ is our proprietary calming complex of Sweet Wormwood (Artemisia Annua), Citron (Citrus Junos), and Pine Tree Leaf (Pinus Densiflora). Each botanical brings anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties — together they help calm the redness and irritation that often follows active exfoliation.

What it does:

  • Reduces visible redness from breakouts and active treatments
  • Soothes irritation and stressed skin
  • Provides antioxidant protection

Peony Root Extract

Peony Root Extract (Paeonia Suffruticosa) is a traditional Korean botanical used for centuries to support skin health. It's rich in antioxidants and polyphenols that help neutralize free radicals from UV exposure, pollution, and environmental stress.

What it does:

  • Provides antioxidant defense
  • Supports skin tone and vitality
  • Helps protect against environmental aging

Adenosine

Adenosine is a naturally occurring nucleoside that plays a key role in cellular energy and renewal. In skincare, it supports skin recovery and helps smooth the appearance of fine lines — making it a perfect counterpart to exfoliating actives.

What it does:

  • Supports skin recovery after exfoliation
  • Smooths the appearance of fine lines
  • Boosts the effectiveness of other actives

Use them 2–3 times per week after cleansing — not daily. Polish Pads are a targeted reset step, not a daily product. Using them more often can overdo the exfoliation and stress your barrier. If you have very sensitive skin, start with once a week and build up.

Yes — they're designed to work together. Polish Pads are your 2–3× per week reset step; Toner Pads are your daily glow step. On Polish nights, use the Polish Pad first (right after cleansing), then follow with a Toner Pad. On the other 4–5 days, just use the Toner Pad. Save up to $125.89 with the Clarify + Glow Bundle →

Yes. The formula is built around our patented GESOLZA™ calming complex (Sweet Wormwood + Citron + Pine Tree Leaf) and barrier-supportive ingredients like Glycerin and Niacinamide — specifically chosen to help reduce irritation while the acids do their work. That said, we recommend a patch test on your inner arm before first use, and starting at 1× per week if you have a history of reactive skin.

Avoid layering the Polish Pads with retinol, retinal, prescription tretinoin, or other strong acids on the same night. Alternate them on opposite nights. On Polish nights, follow with the JIYU Toner Pads and NAD+ Cream, then resume your retinoid on non-Polish nights.

Anywhere you deal with breakouts, congestion, or rough texture: chest, back, shoulders, upper arms, and even the bumpy keratosis-prone areas on the backs of the arms. Avoid broken or inflamed skin, eczema, and the eye area.

The Polish Pads are formulated to help with surface breakouts, clogged pores, congestion, and post-acne red marks. They are not a treatment for cystic or hormonal acne, which needs to be addressed with a dermatologist. If you struggle with cystic breakouts, we recommend talking to a derm about a prescription plan and using the Polish Pads alongside it (with your derm's OK) for the surface-level clearing.

One side is textured for gentle physical polishing — it lifts buildup and surface debris your cleanser leaves behind. The other side is soft cotton for smoothing and refining after. You get both physical and chemical exfoliation in one step, which means fewer products and less risk of overdoing it.

Different jobs.

  • Toner Pads are your daily glow + anti-aging step. Used twice a day with the K8-Rejuvenate complex to keep skin bright, smooth, and even.
  • Polish Pads are your 2–3× per week reset step. Multi-acid system + dual-texture pad to clear pores, smooth texture, and fade red marks.

They're designed to work as a pair, not as substitutes.

The Polish Pads are designed for adults 18+, with our core customer in the 25–55 range. They're especially effective for adult breakouts, post-acne red marks, congestion, and texture issues — the kinds of concerns that don't respond to basic products.

No — JIYU is cruelty-free. We never test on animals at any stage of development or production.
